integrity: Exact matrix arithmetic and standalone verification; every infinite statement relies on a written p-adic lifting proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Only T_n+1 at p=3; the two other roots are given by infinite 3-adic lifts. A finite verifier corroborates explicit integer premises; it is not an infinite proof. Bibliographic uniqueness is not certified.
title: Exact ternary valuation levels and least periods for shifted Tribonacci numbers
